source: Framework data/ contains multiple Draft 2020-12 schemas, including LivePreflight schemas, but no generic integrity test for parseability, unique IDs and resolvable local refs.
objective: Add a dependency-free read-only integrity test over every dev/framework/data/*.schema.json: JSON parse, Draft 2020-12 marker, non-empty unique $id, and resolvable local relative $ref targets without modifying schema files.

coordination.schemas: All existing schema files are read-only inputs in this lot.
coordination.agent_d: DataWiz visualization scopes remain disjoint under wiz/data-wiz-* + tests/doc.
